items.title: Germany's far-right AfD eyes historic state victory in Saxony-Anhalt election
items.standfirst: Germany's anti-immigrant Alternative for Germany (AfD) party is aiming to become the first far-right party to take power at a state level since World War II as voters in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt head to the polls Sunday.
